name: Hur
overview: The name Hur appears in Scripture associated with various individuals, notably an Israelite who supported Moses by holding up his hands during battle against Amalek, ensuring victory (Exodus 17:10,12). Hur is also identified as the father of Uri and grandfather of Bezaleel, a skilled craftsman appointed by God from the tribe of Judah to oversee the construction of the tabernacle (Exodus 31:2; 35:30; 38:22). These references highlight Hur's role in both the leadership and spiritual heritage of Israel during the Exodus period.
